acceptance: The catalog template states absolute worktree paths as a hard rule for members
BenchBox's tracked mirror is re-pinned to the catalog commit and the global deployment pin follows
description: Cross-repository item (joeharris76/skill-sync-skills). The batch member brief template (skills/todo/references/batch.md, step 'Dispatch the member with its item') does not tell a delegated member to pass absolute worktree paths to file tools. BenchBox now refuses such writes mechanically where the harness runs the hook (PR #4143; proven in omp), and docs/agent/batch-feature-delivery.md states the rule, but the template that briefs members is generated from the catalog and still lacks it. This is the unmet part of acceptance 4 of relative-path-primary-writes-recur-after-guard-20261110.
